sand.name: Sandstorm
sand.ambient: A sandstorm rages across the arena!

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: On entry, cows the foe: its Attack drops to ×0.67 until it switches. Blocked by Hyper Cutter, Clear Body and White Smoke.

download.name: Download
download.desc: On entry, scans the foe and raises Attack or Sp. Atk ×1.5 — whichever hits the foe's weaker defence.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: While out, the foe's move cooldowns are 25% longer.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.desc: On entry, reveals the rival's whole hidden team.

slow-start.name: Slow Start
slow-start.desc: Attack and Speed are halved for the first 5 seconds after entering.

arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.desc: The foe cannot switch out while this creature is active. Flying types and Levitate escape.

shadow-tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.desc: The foe cannot switch out while this creature is active (unless it also has Shadow Tag).

magnet-pull.name: Magnet Pull
magnet-pull.desc: Steel-type foes cannot switch out while this creature is active.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.desc: Summons rain on entry: Water moves ×1.3, Fire moves ×0.7 for everyone.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: Summons harsh sunlight on entry: Fire moves ×1.3, Water moves ×0.7 for everyone.

sand-stream.name: Sand Stream
sand-stream.desc: Summons a sandstorm on entry: non Rock/Ground/Steel creatures lose 1/16 HP every 2 s.

snow-warning.name: Snow Warning
snow-warning.desc: Summons hail on entry: non Ice creatures lose 1/16 HP every 2 s.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.desc: Changes type with the weather: Fire in sun, Water in rain, Ice in hail.

cloud-nine.name: Cloud Nine
cloud-nine.desc: While out, all weather effects are suppressed.

air-lock.name: Air Lock
air-lock.desc: While out, all weather effects are suppressed.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Fire moves deal ×1.5 damage.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Water moves deal ×1.5 damage.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Grass moves deal ×1.5 damage.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Bug moves deal ×1.5 damage.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.desc: Attack ×1.5, but physical moves are only 80% as accurate.

technician.name: Technician
technician.desc: Moves with 60 power or less deal ×1.5 damage.

adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.desc: Same-type attack bonus is ×2 instead of ×1.5.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.desc: Normal and Fighting moves can hit Ghost types.

mold-breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold-breaker.desc: Moves ignore the foe's defensive abilities (Levitate, Wonder Guard, absorbs, Sturdy…).

no-guard.name: No Guard
no-guard.desc: Every move by or against this creature hits — no misses, no dodges.

serene-grace.name: Serene Grace
serene-grace.desc: Moves' burn and paralysis chances are doubled.

truant.name: Truant
truant.desc: Loafs around for 2 seconds after every move.

solar-power.name: Solar Power
solar-power.desc: In harsh sunlight, Sp. Atk ×1.5 but loses 1/8 HP every 2 s.

flower-gift.name: Flower Gift
flower-gift.desc: In harsh sunlight, Attack and Sp. Def ×1.5.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: Hovers: immune to Ground moves, ignores tile effects and Arena Trap.

wonder-guard.name: Wonder Guard
wonder-guard.desc: Only super-effective moves can deal damage.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: Survives any single hit from full HP with 1 HP left.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.desc: Immune to Water moves and heals ¼ HP when hit by one.

volt-absorb.name: Volt Absorb
volt-absorb.desc: Immune to Electric moves and heals ¼ HP when hit by one.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.desc: Immune to Fire moves; being hit by one powers up its own Fire moves ×1.5.

motor-drive.name: Motor Drive
motor-drive.desc: Immune to Electric moves; being hit by one raises Speed ×1.5.

dry-skin.name: Dry Skin
dry-skin.desc: Absorbs Water (heals ¼), takes ×1.25 from Fire. Heals in rain, hurts in sun.

shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.desc: Moves' extra burn and paralysis effects don't land.

leaf-guard.name: Leaf Guard
leaf-guard.desc: Cannot be burned or paralysed in harsh sunlight or on the grass Pitch.

suction-cups.name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.desc: Cannot be knocked back by contact moves.

magic-guard.name: Magic Guard
magic-guard.desc: Only takes damage from direct attacks — no burn, weather or recoil chip.

color-change.name: Color Change
color-change.desc: Changes to the type of the last move that hit it.

hyper-cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.desc: Attack cannot be lowered by Intimidate.

clear-body.name: Clear Body
clear-body.desc: Stats cannot be lowered by Intimidate.

white-smoke.name: White Smoke
white-smoke.desc: Stats cannot be lowered by Intimidate.

sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.desc: +20% dodge chance in a sandstorm or in the dusty Cavern; immune to sandstorm chip.

snow-cloak.name: Snow Cloak
snow-cloak.desc: +20% dodge chance in hail or on snow and ice tiles; immune to hail chip.

static.name: Static
static.desc: 30% chance to paralyse attackers that make contact.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.desc: 30% chance to burn attackers that make contact.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.desc: 30% chance to burn or paralyse attackers that make contact.

rough-skin.name: Rough Skin
rough-skin.desc: Attackers that make contact lose ⅛ of their HP.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.desc: When knocked out by a contact move, the attacker loses ¼ of its HP.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.desc: Passes any burn or paralysis it receives back to the attacker.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.desc: Every 3 s, 30% chance to shrug off burn or paralysis.

natural-cure.name: Natural Cure
natural-cure.desc: Burn and paralysis are cured when switching out.

hydration.name: Hydration
hydration.desc: Cures burn and paralysis every second in rain or on water tiles.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.desc: Speed rises 20% every 3 s while out, up to +60%.

ice-body.name: Ice Body
ice-body.desc: Heals 1/16 HP every 2 s in hail or on snow and ice tiles; immune to hail chip.

rain-dish.name: Rain Dish
rain-dish.desc: Heals 1/16 HP every 2 s in rain or on water tiles.

swift-swim.name: Swift Swim
swift-swim.desc: Speed ×2 in rain, ×1.5 on water tiles.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.desc: Speed ×2 in harsh sunlight, ×1.5 on the grass Pitch.
